name: auto-learn
description: Learns skills from your work: after a turn that worked out something reusable, a background fork of the session saves the procedure as a personal skill that Claude Code offers in later sessions.

autoCapture.title: Auto-run capture after each turn
autoCapture.description: After a turn with enough tool calls, fork the session in the background and let Claude save what the turn taught as a skill. Each review uses extra tokens. When off, Claude can still save skills itself with the manage_skill tool.

minToolCalls.title: Minimum tool calls per turn
minToolCalls.description: A turn needs at least this many tool calls before it is reviewed for skills.
